name: Dullahan
description: A headless rider of Irish folklore who appears as a harbinger of death, riding a black horse and carrying his own severed head.

aliases.name: Coiste Bodhar
aliases.meaning: deaf or silent coach (the death coach)

origin: Folkloric range across the island of Ireland, with the densest narrative tradition in the southern counties documented by Crofton Croker and the western counties documented by Yeats and later folklorists.
